title: summit-ultimate-heavyweight
label: Brewster Cogburn

won.source: the Summit's own broadcast of its fourth night (promotions/summit-of-e-wrestling/archive/the-summit-of-e-wrestling-day-4-1991-12-30.html): "The winner, and Ultimate Heavyweight Champion... Brewster Cogburn!"

how: Won from Steelgrave in the belt's own inaugural match, on the second Summit's fourth night. Cogburn had hit the Bulldog Supreme; the belt's own sponsor then clobbered Cogburn with the belt itself, Cogburn fell across Steelgrave, and the referee counted the pin on the man underneath. The sponsor threw the belt onto him in disgust and walked away.
